text:
incident-bot: Pager: [ORG: keystone-labs] sudden org-level traffic spike detected. 16k QPS sustained, error rate climbing 6% on /v1/generate. Severity: high. Paging: @sre_emma. Auto-mitigation suggestions: soften org RL, route to fallback model, or temporary quota bump.

sre_emma: on it. pulling logs + checking per-route throttles and recent deploys. ETA 2m. @ops_matt can you confirm infra capacity in us-west-2?

ops_matt: infra looks healthy, GPU pools at 84% but not saturated. No recent deploys flagged. Might be a client replay. If we lift the org RL by 2x for 10 mins we should buy time.

eng-anya: +1 for temporary RL bump. Recommend also disabling heavy-ranking feature for that org (ranker v3) — it's causing extra tokens. We can flip feature-flag for keystone-labs only.

infra-tom: I can apply a targeted quota bump via admin API. Command:```curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/admin/orgs/keystone-labs/limits" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"qps_org": 32000, "duration_seconds": 600}'``` will set org qps to 32k for 10 minutes. Confirm before I run.

cs_lee: FYI customer success has engaged keystone contact (support@keystone.com). They're seeing timeouts in their app but expect a degraded window. I'll ask them to pause heavy batch jobs if possible.

sre_emma: Do the admin bump + flip feature flag. After bump, enable KV prefix caching for keystone org on the gateway routing (should reduce token churn).

eng-anya: Feature-flag command (FF infra):```POST /flags/targeted-toggle
{
  "flag": "ranker_v3",
  "org": "keystone-labs",
  "value": false
}
``` This will route their requests to ranker_v2 which uses ~40% fewer tokens per request.

infra-tom: Applying quota bump now. `2025-04-07T18:12:10Z infra-tom ran admin API` — response ok, qps_org set to 32000 for 600s.

ops_matt: Flipping feature flag now. `2025-04-07T18:12:22Z eng-anya toggled ranker_v3 -> false for keystone-labs` — propagation to edge nodes in progress.

sre_emma: Observing metrics: QPS for keystone jumped then stabilized, error rate dropping from 6% -> 1.2% over 90s. Token burn per request down ~38%. Good. Keeping on-call here for 15m to monitor.

cs_lee: Customer confirmed degraded but functional, paused batch. They appreciate the quick response.

incident-bot: Action log: [1759876530] pager triggered -> @sre_emma; [1759876570] infra bump requested; [1759876732] feature-flag toggle executed; mitigation window set 10m. Please update runbook and close thread when stable. :white_check_mark:

ops_matt: Suggestion for follow-up: create a short post-incident note with root-cause hypothesis (client replay / batching change) and consider adding an org-specific autoscaling rule in Dedicated to allow brief HR bursts without manual RL changes.

sre_emma: Agreed. I'll open an incident ticket and assign RCA to eng-anya + infra-tom. Will include exact timings and commands used. Leaving thread open until mitigation window ends and metrics stable.

infra-tom: mitigation window expired at 2025-04-07T18:22:10Z, reverted limits to baseline. No immediate re-spike.

eng-anya: Re-enabled ranker_v3 via feature-flag at 2025-04-07T18:22:35Z after confirming token usage back to normal.

sre_emma: Closing monitoring. Final status: keystone-labs traffic stabilized, errors returned to baseline, customer notified. Creating postmortem draft.

cs_lee: Thanks team :heart:
